scope: Production publication of the unified AC-WM, long real-scene, and bounded-training evidence page
summary: PR 1 merged the unified evidence page into main and GitHub Pages successfully serves the AC-WM console, three long real-scene cases, the rank-8 critical-window ablation, prior gallery, and honest failure labels.
evidence: GitHub Pages workflow run 31431227556 completed successfully, including checkout, prepare, upload, and deploy steps.
The production HTML contains the Real-Scene Embodied Lab title, long-case section, A800 task-adaptation section, and the user-rejected H3+EPL label.
Production requests return HTTP 200 for the accepted OSCAR comparison, both 27.5-second flower videos, the rank-8 ablation video, evaluation JSON, and long-case manifest.

Browser verification reports no console warnings/errors, training decision REJECT FULL EXPANSION, motion delta -0.0111, semantic gates 0/4, and successful instruction routing to the 5.4-second LIFT UP evidence.
All three long videos report readyState 4 with durations 20.7, 27.5, and 27.5 seconds; the training ablation reports 2.125 seconds.
lessons: A unified public page should distinguish native AC-WM, geometric retargeting, real observation, generated negative evidence, and failed task adaptation at the card level.
Production verification must check live media readiness and evidence JSON, not only a successful deployment status.
limitations: The accepted OSCAR evidence is camera-skeleton image-space generation, not robot-base control or physical execution.
The H3+EPL 27.5-second candidate is explicitly user-rejected negative evidence, and the rank-8 VACE adapter fails all four real semantic gates.
next_actions: Use licensed paired real robot/action datasets and persistent object-instance supervision before another task-adaptation run.
